name: IFTTT
description: IFTTT is a no-code automation platform that connects apps, services, and smart devices through simple trigger-and-action workflows called Applets.
best_for: Individuals, small business owners, and smart-home users who want simple, no-code automations between everyday apps and connected devices.
features: Applets built from a trigger, action, and optional filter code
100,000+ ready-made Applets plus custom Applet creation
Connects 1,000+ apps, services, and devices including Google, Spotify, Slack, and smart-home brands like Philips Hue and Ring
Multiple actions per Applet for expanded workflows
AI integrations with ChatGPT and Claude for content generation and summarization
IFTTT MCP server connecting AI assistants to IFTTT automations
Pro subscription unlocking unlimited Applets and exclusive triggers/actions

alternatives.name: Zapier
alternatives.description: A no-code automation platform that connects thousands of web apps through simple trigger-and-action workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want fast, no-code automations between cloud apps

alternatives.name: Make
alternatives.description: A visual automation platform for building multi-step workflows between apps with a drag-and-drop scenario builder.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want visual, complex multi-step automations

alternatives.name: Pipedream
alternatives.description: A developer-focused integration and automation platform for building workflows that connect APIs, AI, and databases with code-level control when needed.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want visual workflows with optional custom code

alternatives.name: Zoho Flow
alternatives.description: An AI-powered integration platform that connects cloud and on-premises apps and automates workflows across departments.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses already using Zoho's app ecosystem who want no-code workflow automation across 1,000+ apps

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 2 Applets with unlimited runs and standard Applet speeds.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: $35.88 billed annually; up to 20 Applets plus multi-action Applets, Webhooks, and faster speeds.

tiers.name: Pro+
tiers.notes: $107.88 billed annually; unlimited Applets, AI services, multiple accounts, queries and filter code.

cons: The Free plan is limited to 2 Applets, so even light multi-workflow use can require a paid plan.
Advanced logic, multiple accounts per service, and IFTTT AI services require Pro+, not the lower Pro tier.
